subject: Admin activity exports: format, transport, and timebox (Novamed request)
messages:
From: Eve Park <eve.park@novamed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: 2026-07-20T15:02:00Z
Subject: Admin activity export request for SIG/SOC2 review

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this. Novamed is preparing for a SIG/SOC2 review and we need an admin-activity export that covers: role grants/revokes, privilege escalations, operator session starts/stops, model deploys/rollbacks, admin console logins (successful/failed), and any system-level config changes (IAM, network).

Can you confirm: 1) the raw fields you log for each event (timestamp, user id/email, action, resource id, ip, request id, metadata), 2) default retention and options to extend for a scoped tenant export, and 3) transport formats you support (we prefer SFTP into our collector) and whether you provide a signed manifest for chain-of-custody?

We also need a small sample extract (1 day) and a manifest/proof-of-delivery prior to full handback. Target timeframe is week of Aug 2 if feasible. I can loop in procurement (cc'd).

Thanks,
Eve Park
Security Lead
Novamed
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Eve Park <eve.park@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Admin activity export request for SIG/SOC2 review

Eve — thanks, happy to help. High level answers below; I put options where we typically see customers need flexibility.

What we log (per-event):
- timestamp (UTC, ISO8601)
- actor.identity (user id / email / service account)
- actor.type (human | service | system)
- action (string code; e.g. ADMIN_LOGIN, ROLE_ASSIGN, MODEL_DEPLOY, KV_CACHE_FLUSH)
- resource.id and resource.type (node/pool/model/route)
- outcome (success | failure)
- source.ip and geo (when available)
- request_id and span_id (for traceability)
- raw_payload (request body / changed params) — redacted for PII by default
- audit_context (session id, console/ui vs API)

Retention and export options:
- Hosted default: 90 days full-fidelity.
- Dedicated/Private: configurable retention windows (30d/90d/1yr/3yr) via contract.
- For on-demand handbacks we offer: full day-level snapshots, daily delta exports, or hourly incremental streams depending on size.
- We can apply tenant-scoped redaction rules and deterministic hashing for user identifiers if you want PII obfuscated but linkable across events.

Formats and transport:
- Formats: JSONL (full fidelity), Parquet (columnar for analytics), CSV (summary rows).
- Delivery: SFTP push to your host, presigned S3/GCS URLs (timebox), or managed transfer to your cloud project.
- We support AES-256 encrypted bundles and a signed manifest (SHA256) with HMAC attestation for each bundle.

Proof/sample
- We can produce a 24-hour sample (synthetic customer tenant slice or production slice with PII hashed) and provide signed manifest + MD5/SHA256 checksums.

Timeline and next steps
- To meet the week of Aug 2 handback we need confirmation by Jul 25 on: scope window (start/end), preferred transport & credentials, and whether PII should be hashed vs redacted.
- Ben will follow up on chain-of-custody verification options and we can schedule a short call to walk the sample.

I attached a short checklist that maps Novamed's requested fields to Redwood export columns.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

On Tue, Jul 20, 2026 at 15:40 Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Eve — thanks, happy to help. High level answers below; I put options where we typically see customers need flexibility.

Eve, quick follow-up on the transport/attestation side:
- We can create a signed manifest that includes bundle-level SHA256 checksums plus an HMAC using a per-customer key (we'll rotate keys as part of the handback).
- Timestamp normalization: events are exported with both original_event_ts and export_ts; we also include timezone-normalized indices if you need them for long-range analytics.
- Chain-of-custody: we provide an audit trail showing who initiated the export, who approved it, and the handoff events (SFTP transfer start/complete). We can sign that package with our key and include an attestation statement in the manifest.
- Modes: full daily snapshot vs delta stream. For large tenants we recommend daily snapshots plus hourly deltas for the 72-hour window around incidents.

Note on costs/lead time: a full 3-year retention export for a large dedicated tenant requires 2–3 business days to assemble and validate; short samples or 30–90 day windows are typically same-week.

Kimberly — please confirm the checklist mapping (attached) aligns with Novamed's SOC2 scope and add any DOCIDs they should include.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Product Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Thanks — that looks workable. Novamed's preferences:
- Scope: 2025-10-01 to 2026-06-30 (quarterly sampling + full window for SOC2 readiness).
- Transport: SFTP push to our collector (we will provide temporary credentials).
- PII: deterministic hashing is fine for user identifiers; please do not remove request ids or trace ids.
- Proof: please provide a 24-hour sample (2026-06-29 UTC slice) with manifest and HMAC before full handback.

Procurement (cc'd Samir) will share an SFTP endpoint and SLA requirements; Samir — please confirm budget/PO timeline.

Can we lock in a call Wed Jul 28 10:00 PT to walk the sample? If yes, please send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Eve
Eve Park
Security Lead | Novamed
